LanguageData.BOR_JudgmentShipCannon.label: Judgment-class ship cannon
LanguageData.BOR_JudgmentShipCannon.description: A triple-barreled 33cm naval artillery installation ripped from the hulls of Solarite warships. This is the same gun that once reduced enemy fleets to scattered wreckage before they could close to return fire. On the ground it carries that same apocalyptic weight — three devastating shells per salvo, and a long, ominous recharge between volleys.
LanguageData.BOR_JudgmentShipCannon_Gun.label: Judgment-class 33cm gun assembly
LanguageData.BOR_JudgmentShipCannon_Gun.description: The triple-barrel main gun assembly of the Judgment-class ship cannon.
LanguageData.BOR_Shell_JudgmentShipCannon_Ni.label: Judgment shell (Ni)
LanguageData.BOR_Shell_JudgmentShipCannon_Ni.descript: A 33cm Solarite-charged naval shell for the Judgment-class ship cannon. Detonates with devastating force on impact, sending Solar fragments in all directions.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_JudgmentShipCannon_Ni.label: Judgment shell (Ni) projectile
LanguageData.BOR_Shell_JudgmentShipCannon_Ef.label: Judgment shell (Ef)
LanguageData.BOR_Shell_JudgmentShipCannon_Ef.descript: A 33cm naval shell for the Judgment-class ship cannon. Carries an Efferite charge for catastrophic blast damage and area denial.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_JudgmentShipCannon_Ef.label: Judgment shell (Ef) projectile
LanguageData.BOR_NegotiatorStationDefenseSystem_TII.d: A station-grade spinal artillery system that has absolutely no business being planet-side. The colony mounting rig barely tolerates it, the power grid hates it, and every shot feels like an industrial accident weaponized on purpose.
LanguageData.BOR_NegotiatorStationDefenseSystem_TII_G: A scaled-down station spinal weapon adapted for local emplacement. Every discharge is excessive by any sane military standard.
LanguageData.BOR_Shell_NegotiatorCracker_TII.label: Cracker shell
LanguageData.BOR_Shell_NegotiatorCracker_TII.descript: A catastrophic siege shell intended for station guns, repurposed into a ground launcher that should probably never have been approved. Impact radius is less "munition" and more "regional event".
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_NegotiatorCracker_TII.label: Cracker shell projectile
LanguageData.BOR_Turret_Defender_TI.label: solar defender turret
LanguageData.BOR_Turret_Defender_TI.description: An autonomous defender-pattern double-barreled turret. It fires dense solar sniper rounds at a sustained high cadence.
LanguageData.BOR_Turret_Defender_TI_Gun.label: solar defender autocannon
LanguageData.BOR_Turret_Defender_TI_Gun.description: A defender-pattern autonomous double-barreled cannon assembly chambered for solar sniper ammunition.
